dom.target: Purr, purr~ It feels so good to be petted!

Oops, I stepped on a little pebble.
Perks up her ears, waiting for a reply.
I’ll stay with you through this.

dom.source: 信号发射中，等一个回音

dom.target: Let the bullet fly a bit
Let me chew on this problem
Brain is brewing coffee, almost done
The fish of thought has arrived

dom.source: 让我康康这里面的门道
dom.target: Let me peek at the ins and outs here
Comments are flying through my head.
Putting pen to paper, please wait
Packing the answer into an envelope

dom.source: 把思绪码成整整齐齐的字

dom.target: Picking the best way to say it
Made it to the finish line!
Done! Please pet me for a reward.
All done, what a beautiful finish.
Steady and sure, submitting a perfect score.
Sorted, going for a sip of water.
This round, we worked perfectly together.
All set, all set, wrapping up, wrapping up.
A little hiccup, let's take a breath and try again.
The tool is being stubborn, let's coax it.
Oops, the tool let us down.

dom.source: 这个工具今天不太听话
dom.target: This tool isn't very obedient today.

dom.source: 工具翻车了，扶起来继续
dom.target: The tool crashed, helping it up to continue.
Tool: I'm on strike for three seconds.
Tripped on this step, but it's okay.
Ran out of words, taking a breath.
Said too much in one go, slowing down.
Forced to stop, still wanting more.
Paused and ready, set to go anytime.
Let me peek at this file
Spreading the file out to look
Saving a file to calm down
A little finger work to fix it
Typing a few commands to try
Sending the terminal on an errand
Let the command fly for a bit
Checking things out in the terminal

dom.source: 去外面的世界打听打听

dom.target: Sending a little helper to run errands
You have to make this call

dom.source: 还有 {n} 个工具运行中

dom.target: {n} paths in parallel, clones still busy

dom.source: 还有 {n} 位小助手在加班
另 {n} 个工具在后台跑
dom.target: {n} other tools running in the background
Building a framework in my head first

dom.source: 它在心里打草稿，我垫着脚看
dom.target: The model's drafting a reply; I'm peeking on tiptoe.
Ideas are bubbling up one by one

dom.source: 脑内开会中，都别抢话筒
dom.target: Brain meeting in progress, no mic snatching
Think it through first, acting later is fine
The draft paper is already full

dom.source: 让我听听它下一步打算
dom.target: Let me hear what it plans next
Mm, the plan is taking shape
Words are being written, I'm listening nearby
Sentences are queuing up to leave
Arranging ideas neatly, sentence by sentence

dom.source: 它在组织语言，我打打气
dom.target: It's organizing language, I'm cheering it on
Flipping through materials, I'll stay quiet
Reading line by line, no skipping pages
Finding clues in the pile of papers
Rummaging through everything for key points

dom.source: 动手改起来了，手稳一点
这里补一笔，那边修一修
dom.target: Adding a bit here, fixing a bit there

dom.source: 在改东西，听不到声音才怪
dom.target: Editing things, of course I can't hear you
I can hear the rhythm of the rewriting
Editing briskly, not a line missed
Command sent, waiting for an echo
What's running? I'm tiptoeing to watch
It's working, I won't make noise
Staring at output, waiting for a result
Once this run finishes, it's on it
Going out to fish for some info

dom.source: 翻翻记忆库，等我一小会儿
dom.target: Checking the memory bank, wait a sec
Following the wire to find clues
Digging up old records to compare

dom.source: 手下的伙计在远处跑着
dom.target: My crew is running in the distance

dom.source: 它在看网页，我偷瞄两眼

dom.target: This speed... I'll rest a bit

dom.source: 绿灯一排排，看着就舒坦
dom.target: Rows of green lights, so soothing

dom.source: 全绿，奖励自己一口小鱼干
dom.target: All green, treating myself to a fish
I've got my eye on this error
Don't panic, see what it's saying

dom.source: 修好它，今天才不算白干
dom.target: Fix it, or today was wasted

dom.source: 问题不大，就是有点问题
dom.target: Not a big deal, just a bit of a deal
All done for today, what a perfect day!

dom.source: 没有小鱼干了，多陪我工作一会儿吧～
dom.target: I'm out of dried-fish treats. Stay and work with me a little longer~

dom.source: 粮仓空空，陪我完成几轮任务就会有小鱼干啦～
dom.target: The pantry's empty. Finish a few tasks with me and we'll earn more dried-fish treats~

dom.source: 小鱼干在路上啦，先一起加油工作！
dom.target: The dried fish is on its way! Let's keep working together for now!

dom.source: 嘴巴寂寞了……快去完成一轮任务！
dom.target: I'm craving a snack… Let's hurry up and finish one more task!

dom.source: 陪我多工作一会儿，鱼干自动到账～
dom.target: Work with me a little longer, and dried-fish treats will arrive automatically~

dom.source: 现在喂我也只会饿着肚子说谢谢哦～
dom.target: For now, all I can do is say thank you on an empty stomach~

dom.source: 粮仓见底啦，用几轮任务换一条鱼干吧～
dom.target: The pantry's nearly empty! Let's finish a few more tasks to earn a dried-fish treat~

dom.source: 饿着肚子等你完成下一轮任务～
dom.target: I'll wait for you to finish the next task, even on an empty stomach~

dom.source: 小鱼干藏在你的工作里，去找找看！
dom.target: Dried-fish treats are hiding in your work—go find them!

dom.source: 先工作后干饭，我们的约定哦～
dom.target: Work first, snacks later. That's our deal~

dom.source: 粮仓见底，全靠感情撑着了
dom.target: The pantry's nearly empty, but we have each other.

dom.source: 饿是真饿，活也是真得干
dom.target: I'm really hungry, but the work still needs doing.

dom.source: 画饼充饥……不对，画鱼干充饥
dom.target: Drawing a pie to stave off hunger… no, a dried-fish treat instead!

dom.source: 没鱼干的日子，靠意志力过
dom.target: On days without dried fish, I have to rely on willpower.

dom.source: 下一轮任务，我闻到了鱼干味
dom.target: I can smell dried fish in the next task!

dom.source: 先记账上，欠我两条，记住啦
dom.target: Put two dried-fish treats on my tab. I'll remember!
